authorization.scope: Website Ventures Lab assets and integration
authorization.source: Joey chat 2026-10-01: first research, then up to 100 credits

decision: Reuse the existing Product A stone/tablet source. Compare a direct, fast agency hero against a restrained cinematic treatment. Keep generated footage decorative; real websites stay coded and independently clickable.

audience.buyer: Dutch local service businesses; plumbing/trades first, personal trainers as a second example
audience.visitor: People quickly judging quality and looking for service/contact on mobile
audience.hypothesis: A clear proposition plus relevant premium imagery can improve perceived quality; conversion lift is unproven and requires external testing.

qualityNotes: Existing portrait source is usable for composition review.
Small generated writing is visible on the display; clean this before a final campaign asset.
Do not claim the screen depicts a working website.
Preserve the original. WebP derivatives only resize and encode; they are not new AI outputs.

budget.rule: Re-estimate the exact reference-bearing request before every submission; sum all charged attempts, including rejected creative variants. Never exceed 100. At 50 spent, review quality and remaining funds. Do not restart the budget on a later chat.

jobs.destination: Product A comparison Lab, desktop and deliberate mobile
jobs.prompt: Use the supplied existing stone/tablet image as the strict identity reference. Preserve the exact pale irregular rock, thin black-glass tablet, chrome edge, warm architectural space and restrained oxblood palette. Clean the tablet display to plain dark glass with subtle natural reflections, removing all generated writing and logos. Preserve the rock and tablet proportions. For desktop recompose as 16:9 with calm negative space, not a tight crop. No new props, no fire, no people, no letters or invented interface. Make the 4:5 mobile derivative only from the accepted cleaned desktop winner.
jobs.gate: Same identity; no gibberish; plausible glass/edge/rock; object legible at 390px; exact source traceable.

jobs.destination: Optional agency motion panel; never required to reach examples or contact
jobs.prompt: Animate the exact cleaned reference into one five-second restrained product shot. One pale rock and one thin glass/chrome tablet only. A slow small camera arc with a subtle light reflection, physically stable rock, constant tablet thickness and straight edges. No object transformation, no new devices, no letters, no fake UI, no fire, no water, no hands, no sudden cuts. Finish with a calm hold. Keep all movement within the frame and preserve the architecture. Silent.
jobs.gate: Stable geometry through the full clip; no extra objects; no camera chaos. Review both drafts before finishing. Drafts are not approved finals.

jobs.reference: Accepted still and winning draft; use draft finalization if supported by exact preflight
jobs.destination: User-initiated agency video with poster, pause control and reduced-motion still fallback
jobs.prompt: Finish only the accepted motion direction. Preserve exact identity, composition, materials and controlled camera movement. No reinterpretation or extra effects.
jobs.gate: Exact finalization cost must fit remaining allowance; full video QA before Lab activation; final is not automatically public launch.
